precision: FP32; existing audited CompletionFormer NLSPN6 implementation; no target updates, scale fitting or upper score clipping
preprocessing: Official native DIODE depth values retained without ray/Z conversion; nearest depth and mask, bilinear RGB to320x240 then center crop228x304; native validity mask AND 0.1<depth<=10m. No inpainting.
geometry_limit: Official paper describes rectified metric depth from scans but does not explicitly settle ray-distance versus axial convention here. We evaluate official native depth convention, do not claim an independently verified axial-depth equivalence, and do not compute normals.
primary_population: Intersection of all 11 layouts with at least500 valid points in each; exclusion fixed from GT/masks only, never predictions
aggregation: Mean of per-image metrics: draws then equal-layout family, then image weighted and scene equal; three training seeds separately and mean/sample SD. Primary interpretation scene equal.
uncertainty: Only3 physical scenes: report each scene and each training seed, paired effects and direction counts; no p-values or population-significance claims; no joint independent9-unit claim
retention: External DIODE uniform change reported separately from previously used NYUv2 development uniform change; descriptive2% guard plus1%/5% sensitivity. FullFT empirical baseline, not theoretical bound; no recovery-ratio primary outcome.
decision: Do not retune or create new modules. Report simple-baseline dominance, spatial-null/negative results, heterogeneity and limited3-scene scope. Positive findings only justify further analysis, not immediate new training.
data_use_history: User previously reported no other unused datasets on hand; DIODE newly acquired after this plan. Limited local source-snapshot search found no prior usage; not an exhaustive audit of external parent pretraining.
